info.title: CustomerShipment
info.description: Service to expose shipment endpoints for customers

put.description: Updates the shipment. To cancel a shipment OrderKind must be set to "Cancelled". To update a shipment OrderKind must be set to "Updated"

401.description: Not Authorized to retrieve this Order

get.description: Returns the current values for the shipment requested.

401.description: Not Authorized to retrieve this Order

emailAddressKind.description: the kind of Email Address being entered (Primary, Secondary, Spouse, Work, etc.)

stopSequence.description: The order of the completion of the extra stop.

stopType.description: The reason for the extra stop (Pickup or Delivery).

comments.description: Any special instructions associated with this stop.

packUnPackSupplierId.description: Your identifier for the Atlas Agent Assigned to pack/unpack at this stop.

packUnPackOption.description: The type of packing or unpacking to be performed at this stop. For Pickup stops, it will be assumed to be packing. For Delivery stops, it will be assumed to be unpacking. (Full = Full Packing/UnPacking, Custom = Custom Packing/UnPacking, None = No Packing/UnPacking)

noteId.description: internal note id from your system

phoneType.description: the type of Phone Number being entered (Primary, Secondary, Spouse, Work, Home, etc.)

phoneNumberKind.description: the kind of Phone Number being entered (cell, fax, other)

pickupComments.description: Any special instructions associated with the 'From' address.

deliveryComments.description: Any special instructions associated with the 'To' address.

destinationSupplierId.description: Your identifier for the Atlas Agent Assigned as the Destination Agent for this shipment.

originSupplierId.description: Your identifier for the Atlas Agent Assigned as the Origin Agent for this shipment.

packSupplierId.description: Your identifier for the Atlas Agent Assigned as the Packing Agent for this shipment.

packOption.description: the type of Packing/Upacking to be performed at initial pickup. (Full = Full Packing, Custom = Custom Packing, None = No Packing)

unPackSupplierId.description: Your identifier for the Atlas Agent Assigned as the UnPacking Agent for this shipment.

unPackOption.description: the type of Upacking to be performed at final delivery. (Full = Full UnPacking, Custom = Custom UnPacking, None = No UnPacking)

serviceCustomerName.description: Atlas Assigned Code for your Company

supplierId.description: Your identifier for the Atlas Agent Assigned as the Booking Agent for this shipment.

authorizedWeightUnit.description: Unit of measure for the authorized weight value (AWUCF = Cubic Feet or AWULB = Pounds).
